title: About me
text:
I am a statistician turned data science leader with 16+ years of turning messy data into decisions across India and Switzerland. I lead a team of 10+ data scientists building Automated Valuation Models (AVMs) for the Swiss real-estate market, a regulated, business-critical setting where models must be accurate and explainable. Earlier in my career I worked in consumer retail analytics and media audience measurement, and I have been active in machine learning, text mining and GenAI.
My strengths are statistics at depth (M.Sc. Statistics, mixed/hierarchical models at ETH Zurich), production R (packages, REST APIs and Shiny apps with Docker, Kubernetes and Airflow), and python and SQL for data work.
